1.web: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.

2.web: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
2.asv: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

3.web: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!
3.asv: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.

4.web: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
4.asv: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.

5.web: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.
5.asv: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

6.web: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
6.asv: Letthe high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;

7.web: To execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
7.asv: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;

8.web: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
8.asv: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

9.web: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!
9.asv: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.
